notes: Read the full 234-line numbered source before editing. Covered every import (L1-14), the activityIcon glyph map (L16-25), profileLabel (L27-35), formatDuration (L37-45), formatTimeUntil (L47-53), the VehicleActivity row incl. its expand state, activityColor, pulsing motion.div, vin.slice(-8), activity·profile chip, Clock+Next label, ChevronDown rotate, and the expanded last_decision detail (Interval/Consecutive idle/Battery/reasons/prediction) (L55-107), SavingsCard with its four AnimatedNumber tiles + savings_breakdown bar + legend (L109-183), and the PollingEnginePanel default export with the two useQuery hooks (15000/30000 refetchInterval), the `!status?.enabled` null return, Object.entries(status.vehicles||{}), the header, savings card, vehicle list, and empty state (L185-234). Arithmetic (estimated_in/1e6, confidence*100, (segment/total)*100, vin.slice(-8)), thresholds (ms<=0, seconds<60, minutes<60, diff<=0, total>0, vehicles.length>0/===0), decimals (1/2/0/2), query keys ['polling-status']/['polling-savings'], and every English/i18n string are reproduced exactly.

DOM/web-only modules were replaced with React Native primitives: lucide-react icons (Gauge/Zap/BatteryCharging/Moon/TrendingDown/Activity/Clock/ChevronDown) -> short SemanticIcon-vocabulary glyphs via AppText (SP/ZP/BC/MO/DN/AC/CK and the `v` chevron); framer-motion motion.div pulse (scale [1,1.2,1] @1.5s on `active`) -> a local usePulseScale Animated.loop (1->1.2->1, 750ms+750ms, Easing.inOut) honouring AccessibilityInfo reduced-motion; the clsx `rotate-180` chevron toggle -> an Animated rotation interpolation (0deg/180deg); the web ghost `Button` (which wraps arbitrary children) -> a Pressable with accessibilityRole=button and accessibilityState.expanded preserving the justify-between header layout; `GlassPanel` -> the native GlassPanel primitive (panel padding+gap added explicitly since the native primitive ships no internal padding and the web caller relied on space-y-4). No browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or old web UI components are imported.

AnimatedNumber (web ./AnimatedNumber, not yet ported) is inlined as a native Animated-driven counter with the same value/duration(default 1s)/decimals/prefix/suffix API and the same ease-out-quad 0->value tween (Animated.timing + a JS listener feeding setState, useNativeDriver:false), honouring reduced-motion by jumping to the final value. fmtNumber+safeNumber are inlined verbatim from @/lib/numberFormat (default precision 2, en-US locale fallback, NaN/Infinity guard). activityColor is inlined verbatim from @/lib/colors with the resolved COLOR hex values (active/critical #10b981, moderate #3b82f6, low #f59e0b, idle #6b7280, sleeping #4b5563, default #6b7280). The Tailwind segment colors (blue/amber/purple/gray-500) and emerald-400 text (#34d399 = tokens.success) are mapped to explicit hex; --text-primary/secondary/muted map to tokens.textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted; the chip uses the 8-digit `${color}20` alpha that RN supports natively; the prediction block uses blue-400 #60a5fa.

i18n: the SavingsCard useTranslation()/t(key, fallback) calls (polling.pollsSaved/savedAmount/pollsMade/creditLeft/fleetTelemetry/idleDetection/prediction/sleep) are preserved through a local useNativeTranslationFallback shim that returns the English fallback, matching the established web-parity convention; the panel/header/empty strings that the web source hardcodes in English (Adaptive Polling Engine, Active, Vehicle Activity, the empty message) and profileLabel's Driving/Charging/Idle/Sleeping are kept literal exactly as in the source. State/prop names (expanded, status, savings, vehicles, vin, vs, breakdown, total) and the default-export name PollingEnginePanel are preserved.

Encoding fix: the web source is stored as double-encoded mojibake — `┬╖` (L72), `ΓåÆ` (L91) and `≡ƒôè` (L96) decode (UTF-8 read as CP437) to the intended `·` middle dot, `→` rightwards arrow, and `📊` bar-chart emoji. The clean intended glyphs are written in the UTF-8 native file so the device renders the visual intent rather than the corrupted bytes; this is the only deliberate byte-level divergence and matches how the sibling InsightsEngine port emits clean Unicode (─/→/₂/—).
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
